_comment: REQUEST-PARITY BASELINE. Read by the unknown-key gate in tests/contract-parity.test.ts:
every inputSchema key the route rules() does not declare is either fixed on the tool or listed
here with the reason it is not. IT MAY ONLY SHRINK. An entry that stopped drifting FAILS the
gate and prints the line to delete, exactly like ratchet.json and the two allow-lists next to it,
so the list cannot quietly grow into a blanket skip. Adding a line is a deliberate, reviewable act:
it records debt, it does not excuse it.
The other three request gates (required-field, bound, enum) carry NO baseline, by design: their
drift was driven to zero on 2026-07-27 and every one of those classes is a tool-side fix.
What is in here today, by class:
1. 89 metrics filter axes. The 8 *_metrics tools reuse their entity search filter, while each
{Entity}MetricsRequest declares a much narrower set and the metrics service reads hand-picked
keys off input(filter). Those axes are ignored, which is a silent wrong answer rather than a
422. Narrowing the tools needs the backend to agree with itself first: LinkedinAccountActivityLog
MetricsRequest declares only filter.linkedin_account_sid while its service also reads filter.status.
2. 14 account-share filter operators. The SearchRequest enumerates .eq / .in per field; FilterOp
accepts the whole operator set and McpFormRequest reads input(filter), so .ne / .nin / .is_null
are applied but unvalidated.
3. 7 include params the SearchRequest never declares. Four work anyway (the controller reads
input(include)); three name documented relations no controller builds. Nine more of this class
were fixed instead, with .omit({ include: true }), where the tool named no relation at all.
4. 4 linkedin_tracked_post_sid inputs. The research file documents the XOR with post; the backend
implements only post since the tracked-post entity moved to gs.service.signals.
5. 4 singles: the antidetect BYO-proxy credential pair, one api-keys filter axis, one connection-
requests filter axis, and the notifications metrics group_by the service ignores.
